REGISTRATION OF TITLE ACT, No. 21 OF 1998
Declaration of Determination of the Commissioner of Title Settlement under Section 14

BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 14 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998, I, the undersigned, hereby declare my determination as set out in the Schedule appended hereto in regard to the title to parcel of Land No. 1:111 of Block 02, contained in the Cadastral Map No. 320262, situated in the Village of Bambaradeniya within the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 63 Bambaradeniya in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Udunuwara, in the District of Kandy, in the Province of Central, land parcels which was duly published in the Gazette No. 2407/47 of 25th October, 2024 in terms of Section 55 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998. P. C. D. SIGERA, Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement. Land Title Settlement Department, No. 1200/6, “Mihikatha Medura”, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla, 06th March, 2025
(Published by Authority)
